Kuvitus: aurinkoinen olohuone. Vasemmall: Illustration: a sunny living room. On the left a slanting sunbeam from the window has dust particles floating in it. In the middle, a white column-shaped air purifier with a grille on its side stands on the floor. The dust particles travel in curved lines from the sunbeam towards the grille of the purifier. On the right there are a blue sofa and a potted plant.
Kaksi kaavakuvaa vierekkäin, ei mittakaa: Two diagrams side by side, not to scale. In each, on the left there is a large positive charge Q and to the right of it a point P where a small test charge has been brought. The green arrow E of the electric field at P points to the right in both pictures, away from the charge Q. In the left picture the test charge is positive, and the red arrow F of the force on it points in the same direction as the field. In the right picture the test charge is negative, and the force arrow points in the opposite direction, towards the charge Q.
Kaksi kenttäviivakuvaa vierekkäin, kaava: Two field line pictures side by side, a diagram. On the left a positive point charge, from which twelve green straight field lines start evenly in all directions with arrows pointing outwards; the lines thin out farther from the charge. On the right a positive and an equally large negative charge side by side. The field lines start from the positive charge and curve to the negative charge; the lines are densest near the charges and between them. The lines do not cross each other.
Kaavakuva: kaksi vaakasuoraa yhdensuunta: Diagram: two horizontal parallel metal plates. The upper plate has positive charge and the lower one negative charge. Green field lines go from the upper plate to the lower one. Between the plates the lines are straight, parallel and evenly spaced, so the field is uniform. At the ends of the plates the lines curve outwards and thin out. Between the plates there are two identical positive balls at different places, and on each acts an equally large red force arrow F pointing down, in the direction of the field.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: jännitelähd: Diagram, not to scale: a voltage source U is connected with wires to two horizontal plates, the positive terminal to the upper one and the negative terminal to the lower one. The distance of the plates is d. Between the plates green field lines point down. A positive charge q starts near the upper plate and moves along a dashed line to the lower plate. The same red force F acts on it the whole way, equal to q times E and pointing down. When the charge travels the distance d, the field does the work F times d, which is equal to q times U.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, laskettu simulaat: Graph to scale, calculated with the plate model of the simulation: the electric field strength E in kilovolts per metre at the height halfway between the plates as a function of the position x, when the voltage is 2.0 kV and the plate distance 4.0 cm. The middle of the plates is x = 0 and the end of the plate is x = 10 cm. In the range 0–7 cm the field strength is constant 50 kV/m, which is U divided by d. Near the end of the plate it starts to decrease, at the end of the plate it is about 38 kV/m, and outside the plates at 14 cm it is only about 9 kV/m.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: kaksi vaaka: Diagram, not to scale: two horizontal plates, the upper one positive and the lower one negative; green field lines point down. An electron comes between the plates from the left horizontally, and its blue velocity arrow v points to the right. Between the plates the path of the electron curves evenly upwards towards the positive plate. At a point on the path there are a red force arrow F and an orange acceleration arrow a, both pointing up, against the field.
Kaavakuva: kaksi vaakasuoraa yhdensuunta: Diagram: two horizontal parallel metal plates, the upper one positive and the lower one negative. Green field lines are drawn between the plates from top to bottom. Between the plates the lines are straight, parallel and equally dense, but at the ends of the plates they curve outwards and thin out. Three points are marked in the picture: A is between the plates in the middle, B between the plates near the upper plate and to the left of the middle, and C outside the right end of the plates at the height halfway between the plates.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: pieneen palloon k: Graph to scale: the electric force F on a small ball in micronewtons as a function of the charge q of the ball in nanocoulombs, when the ball is always at the same place between two plates. The grid spacing is 0.5 nC and 10 µN. The measurement points are (1.0 nC; 31 µN), (2.0 nC; 59 µN), (3.0 nC; 91 µN) and (4.0 nC; 119 µN). A straight line through the origin has been fitted to the points, drawn up to the charge 4.5 nC.
